review.notes: All 41 bilingual entries read completely; readiness and crystal-ball image corrected and reread. All reward ranks, scores, currency amounts, response IDs, emotion codes retained. Generic dance partnership avoids speaker/player gender assumptions; spouse dear uses αγάπη μου. Canonical Luau, Governor, Mayor Lewis, Flower Dance, Slingshot and Star Token applied. Native dance response substitutes displayName, retained as a standalone name label.
